line__british_narrator__qwen3__s11.transcript: Nell knelt down in the cold, wet leaves and held out her hand.  For a long moment, the little gray squirrel only trembled.  Then, slowly, he crept into her palm, as light as a falling leaf.  There you are, she whispered.  And for the first time in three long years, Nell smiled.
